name: Santa Gadea del Cid (Spain)
description: Square flag quartered red, green, white and green, charged at the centre with an open yellow book with a black hand laid upon it, recalling the oath of Santa Gadea.
history: Municipal flag of Santa Gadea del Cid; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: open book with a black hand upon it, the oath of Santa Gadea
